articles.author: Michael Birnbaum
articles.title: Trump seeks fertilizer deal with Russia ally Belarus amid Canadian tensions - The Washington Post
articles.description: The proposed potash purchases would expand trade with a country that helped Moscow launch its invasion of Ukraine.
articles.content: The United States is seeking to broker a deal to purchase fertilizer from Belarus and rely less on Canada, the U.S. ally with which the White House has repeatedly tangled, President Donald Trump said… [+7 chars]
